2609.08574.title: Do New Attention Mechanisms Actually Fix Attention Sinks at Million-Token Context?
2609.08574.paper_summary: Long context language models now advertise windows of one million tokens, but two habits limit how much of that window is used. Attention heads with nothing useful to read still spend their budget on the first token, which is called the attention sink, and where a fact sits in the context changes whether the model finds it. Gated attention cut first token attention from 46.7 percent to 4.8 percent at NeurIPS 2025, and Kimi K3 pairs that idea with Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals behind a one million token window, eight times past the range where these diagnostics have been reported. This paper asks whether the fix survives that jump. We build SinkProbe, a suite that measures sink mass, massive activation, position resolved recall and the recency gap, and apply it to four small models that differ only in how they mix tokens and depth. Three results follow. The training objective produces the sink, not the architecture. Gating did not reproduce its published effect at our scale. Sink mass, activations and position bias moved independently. Code, data and the measurement protocol are released at https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window
2609.08574.paper_summary_zh: 長期上下文語言模型現在宣稱可以處理一百萬個標記的窗口，但有兩個習慣限制了這個窗口的使用量。沒有有用信息可讀的注意力頭仍然會在第一個標記上花費它們的預算，這被稱為注意力沉沒，而事實在上下文中的位置會改變模型是否能找到它。門控注意力將第一個標記的注意力從46.7%降低到4.8%，這是在2025年的NeurIPS會議上，Kimi K3將這個想法與Kimi Delta Attention和在一百萬個標記窗口後的注意力殘差相結合，這是超過這些診斷報告的範圍的八倍。本文探討這個修正是否能在這個跳躍中存活。我們構建了SinkProbe，一個測量沉沒質量、大規模激活、位置解析回憶和近期差距的套件，並將其應用於四個僅在標記混合和深度上有所不同的小模型。隨之而來的三個結果是。訓練目標產生了沉沒，而不是架構。門控在我們的規模下並未重現其發表的效果。沉沒質量、激活和位置偏差獨立移動。代碼、數據和測量協議已在 https://github.com/sararizwan7/Attention-Mechanisms-in-1M-Context-Window 發布。
2609.08574.author: Sara Rizwan et.al.
